items.source: The presence of @WebAppConfiguration on a test class indicates that a WebApplicationContext should be loaded for the test using a default for the path to the root of the web application. To override the default, specify an explicit resource path via the value() attribute.
items.translation: 测试类上存在 `@WebAppConfiguration` 表示应使用默认路径加载用于该测试的 `WebApplicationContext`。若要覆盖默认设置，请通过 `value()` 属性指定显式资源路径。

items.source: Note that @WebAppConfiguration must be used in conjunction with @ContextConfiguration, either within a single test class or within a test class hierarchy.
items.translation: 注意，@WebAppConfiguration 必须与 @ContextConfiguration 配合使用，且必须在单个测试类或测试类层次结构中使用。

items.source: A path that does not include a Spring resource prefix (for example, classpath:, file:, etc.) will be interpreted as a file system resource, and a path should not end with a slash.
items.translation: 不包含 Spring 资源前缀（例如 `classpath:`、`file:` 等）的路径将被解释为文件系统资源，且路径不应以斜杠结尾。

items.source: Defaults to "src/main/webapp" as a file system resource. Note that this is the standard directory for the root of a web application in a project that follows the standard Maven project layout for a WAR.
items.translation: 默认为文件系统资源 `"src/main/webapp"。请注意，在遵循标准 Maven 项目布局的 WAR 项目中，这是 Web 应用根目录的标准位置。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations.
items.translation: 此注解可用作 元注解 来创建自定义的 组合注解。

items.source: This annotation will be inherited from an enclosing test class by default. See @NestedTestConfiguration for details.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此注解将从外部测试类继承。有关详细信息，请参阅 @NestedTestConfiguration。

items.source: The resource path to the root directory of the web application.
items.translation: Web 应用程序根目录的资源路径。
